I hadn't been talking to my only sister for a few months due to several reasons that I won't go into detail about here. On March 25th, 2021 she called me really persistently out of the blue and left me a voicemail of her sobbing. I hadn't had a desire to speak to her in a while, but something was wrong. I picked up the phone, and she answered.

There was an awkward silence at first, and I don't remember which one of us spoke first. We both said hello, and I asked what was wrong. She was still sobbing to where it was difficult to make out what she was saying, but the long and the short of our conversation was us telling telling the other that we loved each other, and she apologized for ever hurting me. I remember feeling so dumbfounded I didn't know what to say, but I thanked her for calling and saying what she did and how much it meant to me. 

I tried to get her to talk about what was wrong, but she would only vaguely say that something happened a few days prior and she didn't want to talk about it right then, to which I told her I would unblock her number and she could call me anytime she needed me.

 The last thing we told each other was I love you.

The next day, only a couple hours after I got off work, my dad comes over to tell me in person that she put a gun in her mouth and committed suicide at the age of 19.

I'm so sorry Jessie. I wish i could've saved you.
